runtime_files.summary: Removed stale Windows WGL workaround; added _dawn_canvas_id delegation while open, _pending_resize synchronization for synchronous HiDPI get_frame(), idempotent _cleanup_dawn_resources() across close event/_vispy_close/__del__, and Python 3.13/3.14 asyncio event-loop lookup + TimerBackend._task guard.
Added FrameBufferHelper.close() deleting attached color/depth/stencil render buffers and FBO and resetting _fbo/_fbo_size so Dawn GPU textures retire to 0 bytes.
Removed unused v_linewidth and v_antialias varyings rejected by Dawn WGSL pipeline link validation against agg-point.frag.
Replaced Python 3 float division with integer floor division in _uniforms_list.reserve(int(shape[1] // (count // 4))) and count = len(vertices) // itemsize.
Removed duplicate NullTransform() + str concatenation in __init__, coerced P to float32 with integer itemcount, fixed 2D V[name] slicing, and copied V[:, -2] = V[:, 1] when closed=True.

Coerced P0/P1 to float32 with integer itemcount, allocated V = np.empty(len(P0), dtype=self.vtype), populated 'position' endpoints with itemsize=2*itemsize, and stripped legacy glumpy <viewport.clipping>; token from collections/raw-segment.frag.
